reason: While named individual leaders appear in the text (Moses, Pharaoh, YHWH), there are also other named entities that are not leaders: the Children of Israel/Israel (בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל) are explicitly identified as singing protagonists but are presented as the people being led, not leaders themselves. Additionally, several named nations/peoples are mentioned (Philistines/פְּלָֽשֶׁת, Edom/אֱד֔וֹם, Moab/מוֹאָ֔ב, Canaan/כְנָֽעַן) who are described as witnesses or victims of God's power, not as leaders.
